card.name: Partway through drug-related words
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a longer drug or treatment word, such as the 'yl' in prophylactic, 'lect' in Simulect, or 'az' in midazolam. It appears in drug label text where a medicine name is still being spelled out.

modes.label: Prophylaxis words
modes.description: The 'yl' piece inside prophylactic or prophylaxis.

modes.label: Brand and generic names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name like Simulect, midazolam or ondansetron.

modes.description: The start of the word medication in a heading about preanesthetic medication.
